9:112.text: (The believers whose lives Allâh has purchased are)
those who turn to Allâh in repentance
(i.e. Islâmic Monotheism and all what Islâm has ordained)
(i.e. disbelief, polytheism of all kinds and all that Islâm has forbidden)
, and who observe the limits set by Allâh
(do all that Allâh has ordained and abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds which Allâh has forbidden)
. And give glad tidings to the believers.

9:113.text: for the Prophet and those who believe to ask Allâh’s Forgiveness for the Mushrikûn
(polytheists, idolaters, pagans, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh)
, even though they be of kin, after it has become clear to them that they are the dwellers of the Fire
(because they died in a state of disbelief)

9:114.text: for his father’s forgiveness was only because of a promise he
. But when it became clear to him
is an enemy of Allâh, he dissociated himself from him. Verily Ibrâhîm
(one who invokes Allâh with humility, glorifies Him and remembers Him much)

9:115.text: And Allâh will never lead a people astray after He has guided them until He makes clear to them as to what they should avoid. Verily, Allâh is the All-Knower of everything.

9:116.text: Verily, Allâh! Unto Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, He gives life and He causes death. And besides Allâh you have neither any Walî

9:117.text: (Muslim emigrants who left their homes and came to Al-Madinah)
, after the hearts of a party of them had nearly deviated
, but He accepted their repentance. Certainly, He is unto them full of Kindness, Most Merciful.
